summary: The early background steps carry picture artifacts no brush makes (airbrush blurs, cut-out patches where trunks will go, blue blobs around the trunks) and words that describe a soft blend and faint broken trunks the pictures don't show. Several 'highlight' steps (bark, lit leaves, wing edges, chest feathers) add far more color and modeling than the one named paint, so the paints and words undersell a jump to finished detail. The head steps contradict each other: the cap fills the cheek gap the words reserve, with a seam artifact, and the cheek tip then assumes it goes over gold.
